newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal ends mixed, commercials buy nearbys.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal ends mixed, commercials buy nearbys.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures closed mixed on Monday with nearbys posting gains on aggressive commercial buying and new crop months tumbling on persistent reports of ideal crop weather, traders said.
Soyoil ended lower, taking cues from new crop soybeans which also fell on ideal weather.

Pit sources said Continental Grain bought at least 2,000 lots of soymeal on the day, leading to talk of export business in the works. They noted soymeal values were increasingly competitive in world markets after last week's sharp slide.
New crop continued to struggle with ideal weather.
Forecasts called for showers across much of the Corn Belt this week, coupled with cool temperatures. That scenario should enhance crop development.
Weekend rainfall in portions of China and India also weighed on the market. Some key soybean growing regions in China had been extremely dry.
"They got some rains in Manchuria (China) and the monsoon picked up in India," one trader said.
Soymeal ended $3.80 per ton higher to $0.60 lower with August up $3.80 at $226.40. Soyoil ended down 0.45 to 0.20 cent per lb with August off 0.20 at 21.96 cents.
December soymeal notched a contract low at $186.00 per ton. The previous low of $187.00 was set on July 2. Lows were also set in the January, May, July and August 1998 contracts.
Weakness in soybeans toppled soyoil which had posted gains on Thursday on signals U.S. supplies were priced competitively on the world market.
On the day, Continental Grain was the leading buyer of soymeal, accounting for at least 2,000 lots, traders said. Cargill Inc was on both sides of the market and Refco Inc was a small-lot buyer.
In soyoil, Cargill sold 400 August and Refco Inc sold 300 December and 100 September, traders said.
Soymeal futures volume was estimated by CBOT at 23,000 lots, compared with Thursday's actual volume of 22,307. Soyoil volume was pegged at 15,000 lots, against Thursday's 18,582.
